title: Rafael and the Typewriter
author: L. M. Lockridge
blurb: Bram Thackeray, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
